items.text: Let it be — Gavin is pottering, not asking: greeting a goblin, testing "sit", bouncing off a wall to the east and then sitting down at the camp ashes. No prayer, nothing stuck, and his "what happens now" was already answered an hour ago. A voice out of the air here would only interrupt a man enjoying the quiet.
